text:
For Monzo’s **instant-access savings**, the rate depends on your plan:

- **Free:** 2.80% AER variable  
- **Extra (£3/month):** 3.15%  
- **Perks, Plus or Premium:** 3.55%  
- **Max or Max Family:** 3.80%

Interest is paid monthly. Monzo also offers **Select Access** at 3.45% on Free or 3.70% on eligible paid plans, but it requires a £500 minimum and the rate falls if you make more than two withdrawals in a year. Fixed-term accounts have different rates.

Rates can change; these figures are from Monzo’s current published rates. [Monzo savings rates](https://monzo.com/savings-isas)
